multiple_testing: All rules reported; no inferential significance or winner selection.

rules.absorption_proxy: volume >= 1.5x prior median, small body, close in outer quartile of range; not taker flow
rules.compression_break: prior 20-bar volatility in bottom 25% of preceding 48; Donchian20
rules.donchian20: close outside prior 20 observed bars high/low
rules.donchian48: close outside prior 48 observed bars high/low
rules.equal_cluster: equal weight of >=2 observed directional clusters, mean signed raw >= .35
rules.failed_break20: high/low breaches prior 20 range but close returns inside
rules.flow_divergence: same flow pressure opposed to last completed hourly price body
rules.flow_pressure: BTC/ETH spot+linear fresh native sample imbalance agree at magnitude >= .08
rules.macro_proxy: 3+ exact 4h pair votes, latest completed <=59min before asset bar time, >= 2/3 consensus; asset-specific signs
rules.residual_trend: 4h sum of hourly peer residuals, beta estimated from preceding 48 exact paired changes, |z| >= .5
rules.volume_break: Donchian20 with volume >= 1.5x prior 20 median (positive volume only)
